scope_statement: Gold reference: FX Spot external execution via et-fix-router — integration, market/limit/stop order routing and FIX tags, execution reports, and WebBroker consistency.
_ingest_note: Checklist body migrated from CRT-617-gold.txt into reference_checklist.
reference_checklist:
## Preconditions
- Verify `et-fix-router` services are running
> Execute `dx crmstatus all | grep fix`
> Verify `et-fix-router.market` is UP
> Verify `et-fix-router.limitstop` is UP
- Verify account is allowed to trade FX Spot
- Verify account belongs to group `CornerTraderFxConfiguration → Energy`
> No other profiles from the ExternalExecution domain are assigned to it
> `show m_value h_context account=<account_id> executionDestination@ExternalExecution 1 now`
## Integration
- Verify default configuration is applied
- Verify FIX Logon
> Tag `8=FIXT.1.1`
> Tag `1137=8`
- Verify successful Logon response from ET
- Verify Login Proxy request (35=BE) is sent after logon
> Verify tag `923` (unique Login Request ID)
> Verify tag `553` (Proxy username)
> Verify tag `554` (Proxy password)
- Verify FIX Logout
- Verify connection is restored after interruption
## Market Orders – Routing + FIX
- Verify Buy order (FOK)
- Verify Sell order (FOK)
- Verify correct FIX message type `NewOrderMultileg (35=AB)`
- Verify Fully Filled order
- Verify Rejected order
- Verify group orders
> * OCO
> * Exit OCO
> * Exit Single
- Verify order submission
> Execute command `issue_fx_spot_market_order [instrument] [price] [quantity] [positionEffect] [expireAt] [tolerance] [marketOrderPrice] [timeInForce]`
> * With all mandatory fields
> * With missing mandatory fields
> * With invalid field values
- Verify custom fields are sent ONLY for Market orders
> * Tolerance
> * Price
> * QuoteId
> * SettlDate
- Verify all required FIX tags are present
- Verify order-level tags
> * `35=AB (NewOrderMultileg)`
> * `55 (Symbol)`
> * `1 (Account)`
> * `15 (Currency)`
> * `75 (TradeDate)`
> * `167=FOR`
- Verify Market-specific order type
> * `40=D (Previously Quoted)`
- Verify Leg structure (required for Market orders)
> * `600 (LegSymbol)`
> * `566 (LegPrice) → Order price`
> * `588 (LegSettlDate) → SettlDate`
> * `685 (LegOrderQty) → quantity`
- Verify custom fields (Market only)`
> * `117 (QuoteID)`
> * `6101 (Tolerance)`
- Verify additional Market tags
> * `6110=1 (ExecutionStyle)`
> * `6100=2 (Slippage)`
> * `6120=0 (LegTenorValue)`
> * `461=RCSXXX (CFICode)`
- Verify quote-based logic
> * Price corresponds to quantity at order creation
> * QuoteId matches selected quote
> * SettlDate matches quote data
## Limit Orders – Routing + FIX
- Verify Buy order (GTC, GTD)
- Verify Sell order (GTC, GTD)
- Verify correct FIX message type `NewOrderSingle (35=D)`
- Verify Replace order (35=G)
- Verify Cancel order (35=F)
- Verify Rejected order
- Verify Fully Filled order
- Verify order expiration (GTD)
- Verify group orders
> * OCO
> * Exit OCO
> * Exit Single
- Verify all required FIX tags are present
- Verify order-level tags
> * `35=D (NewOrderSingle)`
> * `55 (Symbol)`
> * `1 (Account)`
> * `15 (Currency)`
> * `75 (TradeDate)`
> * `167=FOR`
- Verify order type
> * `40=2 (LIMIT)`
- Verify settlement
> * `63=0 (SettlType)`
- Verify absence of Market-specific tags
> * `No 117 (QuoteID)`
> * `No 6101 (Tolerance)`
> * `No 566 / 588 / 600 / 685 (Leg fields)`
> * `No 6110 / 6100 / 6120 / 461`
## Stop Orders – Routing + FIX
- Verify Buy order (GTC, GTD)
- Verify Sell order (GTC, GTD)
- Verify correct FIX message type `NewOrderSingle (35=D)`
- Verify Replace order (35=G)
- Verify Cancel order (35=F)
- Verify Rejected order
- Verify Fully Filled order
- Verify trigger condition (price crossing)
- Verify group orders
> * OCO
> * Exit OCO
> * Exit Single
- Verify all required FIX tags are present
- Verify order-level tags
> * `35=D (NewOrderSingle)`
> * `55 (Symbol)`
> * `1 (Account)`
> * `15 (Currency)`
> * `75 (TradeDate)`
> * `167=FOR`
- Verify order type
> * `40=3 (STOP)`
- Verify settlement
> * `63=0 (SettlType)`
- Verify absence of Market-specific tags
> * `No 117 (QuoteID)`
> * `No 6101 (Tolerance)`
> * `No 566 / 588 / 600 / 685 (Leg fields)`
> * `No 6110 / 6100 / 6120 / 461`
## Common FIX Validation (All Orders)
- Verify FIX version and headers
> * `8=FIXT.1.1`
> * `1137=8`
- Verify required tags
> * `1 (Account)`
> * `55 (Symbol in CCY1/CCY2)`
> * `167 (SecurityType=FOR)`
> * `15 (Currency)`
> * `75 (TradeDate in UTC)`
> * `453 / 448 / 447 / 452 (Party fields)`
> * `6111 (PostTradeAllocationIndicator=1)`
- Verify tag is NOT sent
> * `18 (ExecInst)`
- Verify Memo field (5149)
> * Contains 4 comma-separated values
> * Validate format and order
- Verify ClOrdID uniqueness
- Verify OrigClOrdID usage for replace/cancel
## Execution & Data Validation
- Verify ExecutionReport (35=8) is received
> * Order accepted
> * Order rejected
> * Order filled
- Verify no partial fills are processed
- Verify execution data persistence
> * `37 → ET_REFERENCE_ID`
> * `6127 → ET_VALUE_DATE`
## UI & Consistency (WebBroker)
- Verify Route column in Order Book widget
- Verify FIX messages in Order Book widget
- Verify real-time updates
- Verify consistency between console and UI
- Verify ET connections in WebBroker Header → FIX Connections tab
